notes: ACTIVE relation pack (upgraded from pilot). No invented Sn/Sp. Traditional MTrP maps labeled traditional. No Travell verbatim.

relations.clinical_context: Chest or interscapular pain with dyspnoea, diaphoresis, exertional pattern, syncope, or vascular risk.
supporting_evidence: Chest-pain guidelines require urgent evaluation when ACS or other visceral features are present

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Safety pathway, not an MSK test.

limitations: Mechanical thoracic pain exists but must not delay emergency care
recommended_examination: Stop elective MSK cascade if visceral features present
red_flags: Pulsatile chest/back pain concerning for aortic syndrome

references.citation: Gulati M et al. 2021 AHA/ACC Guideline for the Evaluation and Diagnosis of Chest Pain. Circulation/JACC.

relations.clinical_context: Mechanical thoracic pain after visceral safety screen; local rhomboid palpation is not confirmatory.
supporting_evidence: Provocation of thoracic zygapophyseal joints in volunteers can produce referred axial pain patterns

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Provocation maps ≠ clinic palpation accuracy. Do not invent Sn/Sp.

limitations: No Wainner-like cluster for thoracic facet in clinic
Cannot name a segmental level from a pain drawing
recommended_examination: Shoulder load tests if symptoms change with arm use

references.citation: Dreyfuss P, Tibiletti C, Dreyer SJ. Thoracic zygapophyseal joint pain patterns. A study in normal volunteers. Spine. 1994.

relations.clinical_context: Interscapular pain that changes with neck movement, or with weak local shoulder reproduction.
supporting_evidence: Cervical zygapophyseal provocation studies include scapular-girdle referral
Neck Pain CPGs endorse cervical contribution to upper-quarter symptoms

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Cannot localize segment from scapular pain alone.

limitations: Overlaps thoracic, rib, and shoulder sources
recommended_examination: Cervical AROM + radiculopathy cluster as indicated
Ask if neck movement changes scapular pain

references.citation: Dwyer A, Aprill C, Bogduk N. Cervical zygapophyseal joint pain patterns. Spine. 1990.
Fukui S et al. Referred pain distribution of the cervical zygapophyseal joints and cervical dorsal rami. Pain. 1996.
Blanpied PR et al. Neck Pain: Revision 2017 (CPG). JOSPT.

relations.clinical_context: Familiar pain on palpation after visceral and cervicothoracic hypotheses are considered.
supporting_evidence: Classical myofascial maps describe interscapular patterns (traditional class only)

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: MTrP palpation reliability limited. Found ≠ cause.

references.citation: Tough EA et al. Variability of criteria used to diagnose myofascial trigger point pain syndrome. 2007.
Lucas N et al. Reliability of physical examination for diagnosis of myofascial trigger points. Clin J Pain. 2009.

relations.clinical_context: Interscapular pain with dual cervical and thoracic contribution after visceral safety screen.
supporting_evidence: Cross-region cervicothoracic screening is standard when scapular pain is poorly localized
Thoracic-specific treatment evidence is limited (OPTIMa/Briganti themes)

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Coexistence is clinical reasoning, not a single accuracy metric.

limitations: Do not invent a thoracic facet level from pain drawing

references.citation: Blanpied PR et al. Neck Pain CPG. JOSPT.
Briganti / OPTIMa thoracic pain evidence themes — limited treatment certainty.

relations.clinical_context: Pain reproduced by local rib springing or breathing after visceral safety; may be labelled thoracic facet or cardiac by patient fear.
supporting_evidence: Chest-wall and rib pain are recognized MSK differentials after visceral exclusion

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Do not invent Sn/Sp for rib spring. Safety screen precedes MSK labeling.

references.citation: Gulati M et al. 2021 AHA/ACC Chest Pain Guideline — MSK after safety.
Thoracic/chest-wall MSK differential reviews — qualitative.

relations.clinical_context: Posterior scapular pain that changes with arm elevation/load more than with thoracic rotation.
supporting_evidence: Shoulder pathology can be perceived posteriorly

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Familiar-pain mapping over invented accuracy numbers.

limitations: Visceral still first if chest features

references.citation: Lewis J. RCRSP assessment framework.
Blanpied PR et al. Neck Pain CPG — upper quarter framing.

relations.clinical_context: After visceral safety: thoracic rotation/extension reproduces familiar pain without neurological red flags.
supporting_evidence: Mechanical thoracic pain is a clinical pattern; no Wainner-like validated cluster

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: No invented cluster Sn/Sp for thoracic AROM.

limitations: Evidence for isolated thoracic labeling limited

references.citation: Briganti / OPTIMa thoracic pain evidence themes.
Dreyfuss P et al. Thoracic zygapophyseal joint pain patterns. Spine.

relations.clinical_context: Pleuritic pain, dyspnoea, hemoptysis, syncope, or VTE risk — not an MSK special test.
supporting_evidence: Chest-pain and PE pathways require urgent medical evaluation

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Safety pathway, not physio test accuracy.

limitations: Not all pleuritic pain is PE
Do not delay care to complete MSK cluster

references.citation: Gulati M et al. 2021 AHA/ACC Chest Pain Guideline.
PE clinical decision pathway framing — use local emergency protocol.

relations.source_structure: thoracic disc / nerve root clinical construct
relations.clinical_context: Band-like trunk pain with thoracic movement contribution after visceral safety; neurological screen required.
supporting_evidence: Thoracic radicular patterns can mimic visceral or chest-wall pain
Rare relative to cervical/lumbar — do not over-call

references.citation: Thoracic disc / radicular clinical reviews — qualitative rarity and caution.
Gulati M et al. Chest Pain Guideline — visceral first.

relations.source_structure: spinal cord (cervical or thoracic myelopathy construct)
relations.clinical_context: Thoracic or interscapular pain plus gait disturbance, hand clumsiness, hyperreflexia, or long-tract signs.
supporting_evidence: Myelopathy features require medical/imaging pathways before elective MSK care

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Individual signs imperfect; act on constellation. No invented Sn/Sp.

recommended_examination: Neurological screen upper and lower limbs
Urgent referral — stop elective hypothesis cascade

references.citation: Blanpied PR et al. Neck Pain CPG — myelopathy framing. JOSPT.
Cook C et al. Clustered clinical findings for cervical myelopathy — qualitative clusters.

relations.source_structure: serratus anterior / lateral chest wall myofascial hypothesis
relations.clinical_context: Lateral chest wall pain with familiar palpation after visceral and rib/shoulder screens — traditional only.
supporting_evidence: Traditional maps describe lateral chest patterns (traditional class only)

references.citation: Tough EA et al. 2007; Lucas N et al. 2009 — MTrP caution.
Gulati M et al. Chest Pain Guideline — safety first.
